package app

// TestE2E_RejectKeepsWrites (M3c Task 5): gen_vet/m3c-reject's Names.Add inserts a row, stores
// the session and answers Response.invalid "taken". invalid is a successful Task: the insert is
// committed, the session stored, and the page the browser is on rendered again (422) with the
// text on the form that was posted. internal/gen's TestE2E_RejectKeepsWrites writes this file into the module the
// app is emitted to and runs it.

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"html"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/cookiejar"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestE2E_RejectKeepsWrites(t *testing.T) {
	h, err := Serve(Caps{}, Options{DB: ":memory:", Dev: true, Secret: []byte("test-secret-0123456789")})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	srv := httptest.NewServer(h)
	defer srv.Close()
	jar, _ := cookiejar.New(nil)
	c := &http.Client{Jar: jar, Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
		CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}
	do := func(method, path string, form url.Values, hdr ...string) (*http.Response, string) {
		t.Helper()
		var body io.Reader
		if form != nil {
			body = strings.NewReader(form.Encode())
		}
		req, _ := http.NewRequest(method, srv.URL+path, body)
		if form != nil {
			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
		}
		for _, h := range hdr {
			k, v, _ := strings.Cut(h, ": ")
			req.Header.Set(k, v)
		}
		res, err := c.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer res.Body.Close()
		b, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
		t.Logf("%s %s → %d %s Set-Cookie=%q", method, path, res.StatusCode, res.Header.Get("Content-Type"), res.Header.Get("Set-Cookie"))
		return res, string(b)
	}
	session := func(res *http.Response) App__Session {
		t.Helper()
		sc := res.Header.Get("Set-Cookie")
		if !strings.HasPrefix(sc, "alder_session=") || !strings.Contains(sc, "; HttpOnly") || !strings.Contains(sc, "; SameSite=Lax") {
			t.Fatalf("Set-Cookie %q", sc)
		}
		v, _, _ := strings.Cut(strings.TrimPrefix(sc, "alder_session="), ";")
		p, _, _ := strings.Cut(v, ".")
		raw, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(p)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var env struct {
			Iss     int64           `json:"iss"`
			Session json.RawMessage `json:"session"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &env); err != nil || env.Iss == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("cookie payload %s: %v", raw, err)
		}
		s, err := session__codec{}.Decode(env.Session)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", raw, err)
		}
		t.Logf("session %s", raw)
		return s.(App__Session)
	}
	has := func(body string, frags ...string) {
		t.Helper()
		for _, f := range frags {
			if !strings.Contains(body, f) {
				t.Fatalf("body lacks %q:\n%s", f, body)
			}
		}
	}

	res, body := do("GET", "/", nil)
	if res.StatusCode != 200 {
		t.Fatalf("GET / = %d:\n%s", res.StatusCode, body)
	}
	has(body, `<ul id="names"></ul>`, `<p id="adds">0</p>`, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="form"></ul>`)
	// the default session, unchanged: not stored
	if sc := res.Header.Get("Set-Cookie"); sc != "" {
		t.Fatalf("GET / stored the session: %q", sc)
	}

	// post to the URL the form renders (no Referer: the page shown again is then "/", the form's)
	m := regexp.MustCompile(`action="([^"]*)"`).FindStringSubmatch(body)
	if m == nil {
		t.Fatalf("no form action:\n%s", body)
	}
	add := html.UnescapeString(m[1])
	if !strings.HasPrefix(add, "/_/Add") {
		t.Fatalf("form action %q", add)
	}
	res, body = do("POST", add, url.Values{"name": {"ann"}})
	if res.StatusCode != 422 || res.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "text/html; charset=utf-8" {
		t.Fatalf("Add = %d %q:\n%s", res.StatusCode, res.Header.Get("Content-Type"), body)
	}
	// the text on the form, the submitted value kept, the row inserted by the same Task
	has(body, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="form"><li>taken</li></ul>`, `value="ann"`, `<ul id="names"><li>ann</li></ul>`, `<p id="adds">1</p>`)
	if s := session(res); s.N != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("n after Add = %d, want 1", s.N)
	}

	// under Datastar: the same, as a body patch
	res, body = do("POST", add, url.Values{"name": {"bob"}}, "Datastar-Request: true")
	if res.StatusCode != 200 || res.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "text/event-stream" {
		t.Fatalf("Add (Datastar) = %d %q:\n%s", res.StatusCode, res.Header.Get("Content-Type"), body)
	}
	has(body, "event: datastar-patch-elements\ndata: selector body\ndata: mode outer\n", `<li>taken</li>`, `<li>ann</li><li>bob</li>`)
	if s := session(res); s.N != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("n after the second Add = %d, want 2", s.N)
	}

	// a form error: update does not run, nothing is written, the session is not stored
	res, body = do("POST", add, url.Values{"name": {""}})
	if res.StatusCode != 422 {
		t.Fatalf("Add with an empty name = %d:\n%s", res.StatusCode, body)
	}
	has(body, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="name"><li>must not be empty</li></ul>`, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="form"></ul>`, `<ul id="names"><li>ann</li><li>bob</li></ul>`, `<p id="adds">2</p>`)
	if sc := res.Header.Get("Set-Cookie"); sc != "" {
		t.Fatalf("a form error stored the session: %q", sc)
	}

	// the rows are committed: a fresh GET lists both
	res, body = do("GET", "/", nil)
	if res.StatusCode != 200 {
		t.Fatalf("GET / = %d", res.StatusCode)
	}
	has(body, `<ul id="names"><li>ann</li><li>bob</li></ul>`, `<p id="adds">2</p>`, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="form"></ul>`)

	// a click button inside the form (I3): a submit button posting to its own formaction, which
	// Datastar posts on click (preventing the form's submission). Without JavaScript the browser
	// posts the form's fields there; App.Reset has no form and ignores them: a 303 back to the
	// page, the session reset
	has(body, `<button type="submit" formaction="/_/Reset" formmethod="post" formnovalidate data-on:click__prevent="(window._alderBusy||((e,p)=&gt;p))(el, @post(&#39;/_/Reset&#39;, window._alderO?.()))">Reset</button></form>`)
	fm := regexp.MustCompile(`formaction="([^"]*)"`).FindStringSubmatch(body)
	if fm == nil {
		t.Fatalf("no formaction:\n%s", body)
	}
	res, body = do("POST", html.UnescapeString(fm[1]), url.Values{"name": {"ignored"}}, "Referer: "+srv.URL+"/")
	if res.StatusCode != http.StatusSeeOther || res.Header.Get("Location") != "/" || body != "" {
		t.Fatalf("Reset = %d %q:\n%s", res.StatusCode, res.Header.Get("Location"), body)
	}
	if s := session(res); s.N != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("n after Reset = %d, want 0", s.N)
	}
	_, body = do("GET", "/", nil)
	has(body, `<ul id="names"><li>ann</li><li>bob</li></ul>`, `<p id="adds">0</p>`)
}

// TestE2E_AppRefreshToReferer: gen_vet/m3c-reject's App.Reset answers Response.refresh: the page
// the browser is on, the Referer's path and query, again. Without Datastar that is a 303 there;
// under Datastar the page is run again and its body patched in when a GET route of the app
// matches it, and a navigation (a script assigning window.location) when none does. An off-site
// Referer keeps only its path and query (never a redirect out of the app), and a missing or
// protocol-relative one goes to "/".
func TestE2E_AppRefreshToReferer(t *testing.T) {
	h, err := Serve(Caps{}, Options{DB: ":memory:", Dev: true, Secret: []byte("test-secret-0123456789")})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	srv := httptest.NewServer(h)
	defer srv.Close()
	c := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
		CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}
	reset := func(hdr ...string) (*http.Response, string) {
		t.Helper()
		req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", srv.URL+"/_/Reset", nil)
		for _, h := range hdr {
			k, v, _ := strings.Cut(h, ": ")
			req.Header.Set(k, v)
		}
		res, err := c.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer res.Body.Close()
		b, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
		return res, string(b)
	}
	back := func(loc string, hdr ...string) {
		t.Helper()
		res, body := reset(hdr...)
		if res.StatusCode != http.StatusSeeOther || res.Header.Get("Location") != loc || body != "" {
			t.Fatalf("Reset %q = %d Location %q:\n%s\nwant a 303 to %s", hdr, res.StatusCode, res.Header.Get("Location"), body, loc)
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(res.Header.Get("Set-Cookie"), "alder_session=") {
			t.Fatalf("Reset %q stored no session", hdr)
		}
	}
	datastar := func(hdr ...string) string {
		t.Helper()
		res, body := reset(append(hdr, "Datastar-Request: true")...)
		if res.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || res.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "text/event-stream" || res.Header.Get("Location") != "" {
			t.Fatalf("Reset (Datastar) %q = %d %q Location %q:\n%q", hdr, res.StatusCode, res.Header.Get("Content-Type"), res.Header.Get("Location"), body)
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(res.Header.Get("Set-Cookie"), "alder_session=") {
			t.Fatalf("Reset (Datastar) %q stored no session", hdr)
		}
		return body
	}
	// a page of this app: run again, its body patched in; the browser stays on it
	patched := func(hdr ...string) {
		t.Helper()
		body := datastar(hdr...)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(body, "event: datastar-patch-elements\ndata: selector body\ndata: mode outer\ndata: elements <body>") ||
			!strings.Contains(body, `<p id="adds">0</p>`) || strings.Contains(body, "location") {
			t.Fatalf("Reset (Datastar) %q:\n%q\nwant the page's body patched in", hdr, body)
		}
	}
	// a path no route of this app matches: a navigation there
	assigned := func(loc string, hdr ...string) {
		t.Helper()
		j, _ := json.Marshal(loc)
		if body := datastar(hdr...); !strings.Contains(body, "window.location.assign("+string(j)+")") {
			t.Fatalf("Reset (Datastar) %q:\n%q\nwant a navigation to %s", hdr, body, loc)
		}
	}
	// the Referer's path and query
	back("/?filter=Active", "Referer: "+srv.URL+"/?filter=Active")
	patched("Referer: " + srv.URL + "/?filter=Active")
	// an off-site Referer: its path and query only, on this app
	back("/steal?x=1", "Referer: https://evil.example/steal?x=1")
	assigned("/steal?x=1", "Referer: https://evil.example/steal?x=1")
	// a path that a browser would read as another host, and no Referer at all: "/"
	back("/", "Referer: https://evil.example//evil.example/x")
	patched("Referer: https://evil.example//evil.example/x")
	back("/")
	patched()
}
